market.conclusion: The market is hostile for short-term trades. Monday's big jump (SPY +4.71%, QQQ +7.0%) left both below their 50-day and 200-day averages, only 3% of stocks are above their 50-day average, and fear was high (VIX 35.89 on Nov 20). It's a time for patient, staged long-term buying, not for chasing swings.
arguments: Macro (against everything): tech is in a downtrend, fear is high and all 5 trading-condition checks fail. I weigh this heavily for swing calls. I note that the conditions gauge is experimental and restricts nothing.
Technical: most names show lower highs and lower lows below their 50-day average. One rally day doesn't change that, so I agree with it.
Fundamental: several strong businesses (NVDA, NFLX, ORCL) now trade at or below fair value. That's a real long-term argument, but it doesn't make the next few weeks safe.

Credit and rates: credit spreads are steady (3.52, no lending stress) and the 10-year yield is little changed at 5.04. This is a mild offset that suggests a sell-off driven by fear, not a funding crisis.
Quant: no validated signals and 0 of 696 forecasts scored. I give it no weight.
Defensive sectors lead: consumer staples are up 8.38 points versus SPY over 20 sessions and tech is down 7.22 points. Money is hiding, not buying tech.
market.change_mind: Daily closes above $733.39 on SPY and $664.39 on QQQ, with the VIX back under 30 and credit spreads still steady. Also watch the GDP and PCE inflation data on 2026-11-25.

deep_dive.case_for: It's a grade A business at $165.05, below its whole value range ($191.49–$411.04). Revenue grew 83.38% over the last 12 months, the forward P/E is 7.56, and estimates rose 4.34% in 30 days. This is the clearest long-term bargain on the list.
deep_dive.case_against: The chart is broken: price is below its 50-day ($206.08) and 200-day ($203.24) averages, with lower highs and lower lows. Operating margin of 65% is at the top of its 5-year range, unpaid customer bills rose faster than sales (127% vs 106%), and insiders sold $946.6M outside pre-set plans. Headlines also show leadership turmoil: Huang's exit, then a board reinstatement.
deep_dive.decides: For the long term, whether the peak margin holds. For a swing, a close above $180.81 would confirm strength and a close below $147.15 would break the range. Until then, build any long-term position in small pieces.
